name: Juanes Mexican Restaurant
tagline: Breakfast and Mexican plates on West 4th Street in Cameron.
about: Juanes Mexican Restaurant at 302 W 4th St in Cameron opens early for breakfast and serves Mexican plates through the day.
It has a drive-through for takeout.
sources: Address, phone, early Monday and Sunday hours, drive-through: https://www.restaurant.com/locations/juanes-mexican-restaurant-cameron-302-w-4th-st
conflicts: Weekday closing times differ between listings (9 PM vs 10 PM), so the page leaves hours off. Some listings give 300 W 4th St.
